detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Background Story

An unknown fungal spore virus suddenly breaks out, turning the infected into bloodthirsty "Fungi Corpses" in their madness. Players take on the role of an ordinary female office worker, fighting against various enemies to find her missing younger sister.

Game Features

  • Dark and horror atmosphere

  • 2.5D side-scrolling shooter

  • Clothing battle damage

About the Developers

This is a post-apocalyptic themed game developed by the two of us. We hope to bring you a unique gaming experience and appreciate everyone’s support.
